display_name: 完整源数据 PAMF 原型参数三种子七景对照
description: 固定比较三种数据配置的 11 个新参数，每个种子继承匹配原 E20，逐行自动预测并独立评分。
authorization: 2026-11-12 用户要求不留源域开发集，使用原数据和对应权重，训练后自动七景测试。

code.commit: actual committed release identity in runtime.json

data.dataset: ManyRx ten-class, ManySig 1%-labeled and ManySig six-source-receiver
data.contract_ref: context.handles indexed by each row protocol_id
data.physical_ids_ref: each original source and test contract

roles.L_s: entire original labeled role for each configuration; no internal holdout
roles.U_s: original source U; true TX hidden

data.validation_ref: existing data roles; Phase2 capsule not applicable
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 frozen direct predictions; independent truth-last per row
data.leo_config_ref: original six practical scenario views, identical physical IDs per matched row

permissions.query_use: frozen predictions then independent truth-last per row
permissions.claim_scope: exploratory on previously exposed test sets; fixed matrix, no target feedback into training or selection

checkpoint.initialization: matching original full-L Tri E20 by configuration and model seed, then own E10+E20
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: original same-data same-seed scratch E20; no development holdout or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: all 33 declared new parameter rows; fixed final E50; no target-driven selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPUs 0,1,3,4,5,7,2,6; at most one this-run worker and two total processes per card, counting other owners; check free memory
execution.stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch; preserve healthy workers, outputs and other owners

expected_artifacts: same-setting same-seed matched PL and original prototype comparisons, three-seed summary

notes: 11 parameter variants across the three requested data settings, each with the original three model seeds.
Previously completed original prototype and ordinary PL scores are reused, not retrained.
Each row automatically predicts all seven views and independently scores after that row completes.
The same benchmark was previously exposed; comparisons are exploratory and do not feed training, candidate selection or reruns.
The separate completed development-only models are tested as requested but are not mixed with these full-source matched comparisons.
